resources.string: Make a code that lets you reset the Super Admin password
If you forget the Super Admin password, this code lets you set a new one. Nothing else can: the app has no server and no one at Invision can reset it for you.
You will see the code once. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this device. Anyone who has it can reset your password.
